reason: The finding holds. It proposes no build and no submit, so feasibility is trivial (nothing to switch off, no runtime, no rule touched). Its value claim is 'avoid negative-EV slot use', and the pre-registered rules back it more firmly than the finding says. (1) R13-A1 (1) and (5), registered before any score, say 'No other rung: no threshold neighbours (I-310), no class C' and 'At most 5 ladder submits in total'. Probes 39-42 plus the post-hoc 43/44 already make 6. A DC 0.175 rung would be a 7th, post-hoc public knob step fitted on one embryo (29% of the test). The lab has no predictive power for this knob: dc0.30 lab +0.0013 vs public -0.005; dc0.20 lab 0/-0.0008. So its private EV is ~0 or below. It is also never a final under L9 without a user letter. (2) A 'DC 0.20 + fm45' combo is excluded twice: L5v2 needs a POS BASE, and D1 (04:58Z) found BASE none, so no combo whatever probe 42 shows; and any file with a class-C knob is class C. (3) The 'twin + DC 0.20' file hedges the insertion i but not the DC delta d. d moves the public score by ~0.005 per 0.05 step, while P(i<0) is ~0.10-0.20, so {V*, #37} is the better shape in most worlds. It would also need a new ~7.5 h run and a dummy, for a class-C file. (4) In-block rank stays info only (I-230). Also, the watcher's hard cap (11:30Z) does not cover 43/44, so no attributable in-block read exists anyway. Minor inaccuracies, none of which change the verdict: (a) 'burns one of the 2 remaining slots' binds only on 27 Sep (5/day per team, CONTEXT l.343). A rung informed by 43/44 (~13:00Z) could go on 28 Sep, so the real objection is the pre-registered rule, not slot scarcity. (b) '(b) dominates' rests on the scan's illustrative Monte-Carlo, which I-092 flags as false precision. It should read 'worse than (b) in most illustrated worlds'. (c) A DC rung is a knob, not a new mechanism, so R8's 12:00Z line does not formally apply. The ban comes from L5v2/I-310, not from R8.
fix: Keep the action as written: 2 slots on 27 Sep for an E10 port or an ERROR resubmit; no further DC rung or combo; 'DC threshold sensitivity per embryo' goes to the post-deadline LESSONS list. Reword the rationale: (i) cite R13-A1 (1)/(5) (no threshold neighbours, no class C, at most 5 ladder submits; 39-44 = 6 already, so 43/44 were a logged post-hoc exception, not a precedent) as the binding reason, and extend the ban to 28-29 Sep slots, not just the 2 left on 27 Sep; (ii) change '(b) dominates it' to 'worse than (b) in most illustrated worlds (arithmetic illustration only, I-092)'; (iii) say the DC-rung ban comes from L5v2/I-310, and that R8 is about new mechanisms. Optionally add to LESSONS: if both 43 and 44 display <= 0.953, DC 0.25 is a local public optimum on both sides; if 43 > 44 > K2, record the monotone trend as a fact, not as a trigger for a 0.175 rung.
realistic_gain: 0 on private and 0 runtime; it avoids a ~0 or negative private-EV public-fitting submit and keeps port/resubmit capacity. The value is procedural (rule discipline and slot hygiene), not score.
